metadata.methods_description: Resting-state EEG recordings were obtained from 25 PD patients (15 Neuroepo, 10 placebo) at baseline and 6-month follow-up. Qualitative EEG analysis was performed by two independent experts using a Likert-type scale. Quantitative EEG analysis employed source localization using VARETA software with co-registration to the Montreal Neurological Institute Atlas. Statistical comparisons between groups and timepoints were conducted using permutation tests and contrast methods with Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.
